Class DesignService

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.mcp.DesignService
@Service public class DesignService extends Object
Stage 1 ingest: turn pasted story text or a workspace file into a reviewable pack. Does not write files and does not fetch URLs (issue #5947).

  • Method Details

    • ingest

      @Tool(name="design_ingest", description="turns pasted user-story or acceptance-criteria text, or a workspace file, into a structured Design pack with actor, outcome, and numbered AC IDs; never writes files and does not fetch URLs") public McpDesignPack ingest(String text, String filePath, String sourceUrl)
      Ingests a user story or acceptance criteria into a structured pack.
      Parameters:
      text - pasted story text
      filePath - workspace-relative file to read
      sourceUrl - recorded source URL (not fetched)
      Returns:
      pack; wroteFiles is always false

    • analyze

      @Tool(name="design_analyze", description="runs the requirements-analysis playbook on a story or workspace file and returns a gap register with stable GAP IDs; never writes files and does not generate Gherkin") public McpDesignAnalysis analyze(String text, String filePath, String sourceUrl, String acceptedGapIds)
      Runs the requirements-analysis playbook against an ingested pack.
      Parameters:
      text - pasted story text
      filePath - workspace-relative file to read
      sourceUrl - recorded source URL (not fetched)
      acceptedGapIds - comma-separated waivable GAP IDs to accept, or empty
      Returns:
      analysis; wroteFiles is always false and Gherkin is never emitted
